_comment: Pisces's INN register. Attached ONLY to pisces_inn_guest; his street hub (pisces_magic) never rides along, so the magic tutoring, the necromancy defence and EVERY door consult stay home-only -- reinforced now that door_mounting.json exists on this same map: the guest row must never touch door mechanics. A magic question is DEFLECTED in the greet, never answered. Serve mirrors selys_inn/patron_serving: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound, banks the shared served_customer counter. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: haughty THAWING.

greet.speaker: Pisces
greet.text: You are the one with the trays. I am not here for the cuisine, you understand, nor to discuss my work over it. The fire is adequate. My rooms are not.

text_variants._comment: #349 residence arm: once the Horns move into the corner (seal_kept_reported), his own reason for being in this room is THEM, not the stew. Stays REGISTER-PURE -- no magic, no door mechanics, exactly as the file contract requires.
text_variants.text: My team have annexed the corner by the fire and appear to consider the matter settled. I am here to observe the decline at close range. The fire remains adequate. My rooms remain not.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

offduty.speaker: Pisces
offduty.text: Tavern fare is a solved problem. Salt, fat, and enough of it that nobody asks a second question. I have eaten better in three cities. I have eaten considerably worse in nine. I decline to say where this kitchen falls between them.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

served.speaker: Pisces
served.text: ...Hm. It is competent. Do not read anything into that; I have called far worse things competent. Though I observe that I have finished it, and I observe you observing.
